questions.question: Before joining a four-exit roundabout like Queslett, who has priority?
options: Traffic already on the roundabout from your right
Traffic entering from the left arm
questions.explanation: Rule 185 says give way to traffic approaching from your right.

questions.question: When should you signal left to leave Queslett onto Aldridge Road?
options: Just after passing the exit before Aldridge Road
Only after you have fully left the roundabout
questions.explanation: Rule 186 says signal left after passing the exit before yours.

questions.question: How should you handle two-lane circulatory markings on a large roundabout?
options: Stay in your lane and follow the road markings
Cut across both lanes to shorten the curve
Stop on the roundabout to check signs
questions.explanation: Rule 186 says keep in your lane and follow the markings.
